facts.fact: According to the UNWTO (as cited by StackAdapt), international tourism is expected to return to pre-pandemic levels in 2024.
facts.quote: international tourism expected to return to pre-pandemic levels in 2024, [according to the UNWTO]

facts.fact: A Nationwide survey, as cited by StackAdapt, found that 91% of US consumers plan to travel domestically in 2024.
facts.quote: reveals that 91% of US consumers plan to travel domestically, and 50% intend to travel internationally in 2024.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that its proprietary machine learning algorithm for segmenting relevant audiences is covered by US patent 11,748,776.
facts.quote: (US patent 11,748,776) to segment relevant audiences based on the content travellers consume online.
